hero.bgAlt: The house with apartments Mare and Gumbek in Petrčane — white façade, balconies and a parking courtyard
hero.h1:
Apartments Mare & Gumbek
two homes under one roof.
hero.p: Two separate apartments in the same house in Petrčane — each with its own kitchen, bathroom, air conditioning and outdoor space. The beach is a ten-minute walk away, Zadar a quarter of an hour by car. Ideal for two families or groups travelling together who still want a place of their own.
